subject: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>, Jean-Paul Laurent <jean-paul.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 2, 2026 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

Team — pulling this together so we don’t thrash between partner submission forms, docs URLs, and security wording.

Goal: lock a publish plan + owners + review deadlines for the marketplace onboarding docs (AWS + GCP) so Partnerships can submit with stable URLs and we can support buyers without one-off SE loops.

Proposal (high level):
1) Public docs (docs.redwoodinference.com)
- Marketplace onboarding landing page
- AWS: subscribe → entitlement → org provisioning → first API key → first call
- GCP: same flow + GCP billing dimension notes at a high level
- Troubleshooting guide for entitlement propagation delays + common console error codes
- Marketplace buyer FAQ (procurement, billing, support routing)

2) Public security overview (marketplace-friendly)
- What we collect/store, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logs availability, retention defaults (high-level)
- Shared responsibility: what Redwood manages vs customer obligations

3) Gated / on-request (not fully public)
- SOC 2 report + evidence links
- Detailed control mappings

Review gates (asking for explicit sign-off):
- PMM (Soojin) for copy claims + SKU naming consistency
- Security/GRC (Aisha/Olga) for any security statements
- Marketing (Camila) for tone/positioning alignment

Deadlines (to hit partner review windows):
- Tue 2/3 EOD: content freeze in docs PRs (only review changes)
- Wed 2/4 12pm PT: Security/PMM sign-off
- Wed 2/4 EOD: merge + publish
- Thu 2/5: final URL list to Partnerships + submit

Open items I need help confirming today:
A) Canonical URLs and redirects needed for partner portals (we should not change these after submission)
- /marketplace
- /marketplace/aws
- /marketplace/gcp
- /marketplace/troubleshooting
- /security/marketplace (or /marketplace/security?)

B) Ownership after launch (who maintains what, and how changes land)
- I suggest: DevEx owns IA/navigation + “how to” steps; Security owns security overview wording; PMM owns FAQ procurement/billing language.

Attaching v5 publish plan + URL map.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
DevEx Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Marketplace_Onboarding_Docs_Publish_Plan_v5.pdf
Attachment: Marketplace_Docs_URL_Map_20260202.csv


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>, Jean-Paul Laurent <jean-paul.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 2, 2026 at 10:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

+1 to freezing URLs.

Re: URL scheme — I strongly prefer keeping all marketplace pages under /marketplace/* so we can hand a clean list to AWS/GCP and keep internal linking sane.

Recommendation:
- /marketplace (overview + “Choose Hosted/Dedicated/Private”)
- /marketplace/aws (AWS-specific subscription/entitlement notes)
- /marketplace/gcp
- /marketplace/troubleshooting (entitlement delays + common console errors)
- /marketplace/security (marketplace-friendly security overview)

If we agree, I’ll comment in PR-3421 to align frontmatter + nav and we can create redirects for any previous drafts.

Also flagging: INT-771 is still open for redirects/vanity URLs. We should ensure the above are the final targets so we don’t have partner forms pointing at temporary pages.

— Elliot
Elliot Price
Docs Lead | Redwood Inference


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>, Jean-Paul Laurent <jean-paul.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 2, 2026 at 11:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

Works for me with one caveat:

Please avoid any hard numbers/SLAs in the public onboarding pages unless they’re already approved language. Marketplace reviewers are sensitive to “guarantees” in the listing + linked docs.

Copy constraints (quick reminders):
- Use “SLA-backed options available for Dedicated” rather than quoting uptime %.
- Don’t say “SOC 2 certified” (say “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA/on request”).
- For residency/retention: keep it to “region selection options and configurable retention controls” and point to the security page.

If you send me the final page list + top-level headings today, I’ll do PMM sign-off by Wed 12pm PT.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Marketing | Redwood Inference


From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>, Jean-Paul Laurent <jean-paul.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 2, 2026 at 12:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

Agree on the overall plan.

Security notes we need to be consistent on (esp. for marketplace reviewers):
1) Data handling language
- Be explicit that prompts/outputs are processed to provide the service; avoid implying we “store by default forever.”
- Keep retention statements aligned with the marketplace data handling doc. Don’t add new defaults in the public pages.

2) Encryption/KMS
- It’s OK to say “encryption in transit and at rest; KMS integrations for Private deployments” but avoid specific implementation claims unless already reviewed.

3) Audit logs
- We can say audit logs are available for enterprise plans and can be exported. Don’t list every event type in the public page; that belongs in the packet.

Olga and I can sign off Wed morning if you point us to the final rendered pages (not just PR diffs).

— Aisha
Dr. Aisha Rahman
Security Executive Sponsor | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 9:36 AM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

I can own the Hosted onboarding steps + troubleshooting text for:
- “Link your marketplace subscription to a Redwood org”
- “Create your first API key”
- “Make your first request” (with a minimal cURL + SDK snippet)

One request: we should include a clearly labeled “Entitlement propagation delay” callout with a retry window + what to do if it exceeds that window (open support ticket, include subscription ID, etc.). This was the #1 drop-off in the dry run.

I’ll push final edits into PR-3421 by EOD today.

— Wei
Wei Chen
DevEx Writer (Hosted onboarding) | Redwood Inference


From: Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, Feb 3, 2026 at 1:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

I’ll take ownership for the Dedicated/Private sections where we need them, but I’d prefer we keep those pages thin.

What I propose for launch:
- Marketplace overview page: include a “When you should talk to us” section (Dedicated capacity sizing, Private/VPC/on-prem prerequisites).
- Dedicated/Private: link to existing product docs + “Contact Sales/SE” rather than trying to document deployment architecture inside the marketplace onboarding flow.

For ongoing updates post-launch:
- Any change that impacts the subscription→entitlement→provisioning steps should be treated as a product change and reviewed with Chloe/Eng (even if docs-only).

— Kira
Kira Thompson
DevEx Writer (Dedicated/Private) | Redwood Inference


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Kira Thompson <kira.thompson@redwoodinference.com>, Jean-Paul Laurent <jean-paul.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 4, 2026 at 4:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding docs — publication plan + review deadlines (AWS/GCP submission)

Locking decisions + owners based on this thread.

1) Canonical public URLs (final for partner submission)
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/aws
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/gcp
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/troubleshooting
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/security

Elliot: please ensure nav/frontmatter matches this and call out if any redirect is needed (INT-771).

2) What’s public vs gated
Public:
- Onboarding steps (AWS/GCP)
- Troubleshooting
- Marketplace buyer FAQ
- Marketplace security overview (high-level)

Gated/on-request:
- SOC 2 report + detailed evidence index

3) Ownership after launch
- DevEx (Alex): overall IA + update triage, ensure pages remain consistent with product UX
- Docs Lead (Elliot): site structure, redirects, and versioned publishing process
- Hosted onboarding content (Wei): step-by-step + troubleshooting copy for Hosted flows
- Dedicated/Private pointers (Kira): minimal copy + links; escalate anything architectural to SE
- PMM (Soojin): procurement/billing FAQ language + SKU naming consistency
- Security/GRC (Aisha/Olga): security overview wording and any claims related to encryption, retention, audit logs, compliance posture

Operating rhythm:
- Monthly: quick audit of the marketplace pages for drift (15 min rotation; DevEx owns)
- Quarterly: formal review with PMM + Security (owners above)
- Hotfix SLA: if onboarding steps break due to console changes, DevEx will patch docs within 1 business day and open an internal ticket for the underlying product mismatch

Next steps (today/tomorrow):
- I’m merging PR-3421 + PR-3422 once Security + PMM sign-off comments land.
- Separate PR-3423 (pricing/packaging) can merge after; it doesn’t block partner submission but we should include stable links from /marketplace.

Thanks all — this is the last big moving piece before we hand URLs to Partnerships.

— Alex
Alex Martinez
DevEx Lead | Redwood Inference
